gaps.title: Education platforms may be exempted from the under-13 data rule by a resolution that does not exist yet
Teenagers' consent is not addressed by the PDPL
The same AI tutor falls under different data-protection regimes depending on who deploys it
No binding risk class, logging duty or incident channel for AI systems used with students
Approved-tool and age rules cover MoE-curriculum schools; Dubai private schools on other curricula wait for KHDA
Several regulators can claim a children's-data AI incident; none is named lead
